title: Numeric migration ordering for complete Staging MariaDB replay

phases.objective: Make the local exact-main Staging schema bundle replay apply migrations by numeric version prefix before filename tie-breaker, so migration 310 creates activation_runs before migration 1042 creates its session-context index.

e2e_journeys.actor: Staging schema bundle generator and disposable local MariaDB 11.4
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The exact local checkout validates the role manifest and ordered pre-use audit, then applies the baseline and numeric-prefix ordered migration chain in a disposable MariaDB schema.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: activation_runs is created by migration 310 before migration 1042 indexes it, the three schema-only bundles can be emitted, and no Production/provider/Cloudflare/credential/data operation occurs.
steps: Load the canonical baseline schema without external data or authority statements.
Order every SQL migration by its numeric filename prefix and use the complete filename as a deterministic tie-breaker.
Run the ordered pre-use audit using the same comparator as the builder.
Apply the migration chain only in disposable local MariaDB 11.4 after explicit confirmation and exact-SHA checks.
Emit runtime, governance, and runtime-persistence schema-only bundles with a safety manifest.
assertions: Migration 310 precedes migration 1042 in the builder and pre-use audit order.
Every migration filename has a numeric version prefix.
The manifest ordering contract matches the comparator implementation.
The builder remains fail-closed on wrong SHA, dirty tree, non-local Docker, missing confirmation, SQL failure, or missing outputs.
Production, providers, Cloudflare, credentials, data export, and runtime mutations remain forbidden.
